What we cater

Pure veg catering for every Tamil celebration in Chennai

One pure-vegetarian kitchen for weddings, house functions, corporate events, pujas and community feasts, from 30 guests to 2,500 plates. Every menu is customisable, cooked fresh the same day, and served the traditional way on banana leaf. Pick your occasion below for menus, how the day runs, and a quote.

Message us on WhatsApp

  • Wedding & reception catering

    நிச்சயதார்த்தம் · திருமணம் · வரவேற்பு

    From the morning muhurtham saapadu to the evening reception, we serve a full traditional virundhu sappadu on banana leaf: sweets, sambar, rasam, kootu, poriyal, varuval, payasam and more. Our cooks and servers run the whole day, so your family can be guests at your own wedding.

    Wedding & reception catering → Or ask on WhatsApp

  • Housewarming & seemantham catering

    கிரகப்பிரவேசம் · பால் காய்ச்சுதல் · வளைகாப்பு · சீமந்தம்

    Griha pravesam, seemantham, naming ceremonies and family milestones, catered with the warmth of a home kitchen. Right-sized menus from 30 guests, cooked fresh and served hot, right down to the sambar.

    Housewarming menus → Seemantham menus →

  • Corporate & bulk meal catering

    Office lunches, conferences and bulk daily meals across Chennai: hygienic, punctual and priced for regular volume. From idli-dosai breakfasts to full South Indian lunch spreads, delivered on schedule, every time.

    பூஜை · ஹோமம்
